project_kinds.name: Mieterstrom
project_kinds.description: Tenant electricity: electricity from a solar installation on, at or in a building, supplied by its operator or a third party to final consumers in that building, its ancillary buildings or buildings of the same neighbourhood, without passing through a grid, under a supply contract that also covers the rest of their needs.
project_kinds.reference: EEG 2023, § 21 (3) (the tenant electricity premium and its perimeter); the supply contract is EnWG § 42a

project_kinds.name: Gemeinschaftliche Gebäudeversorgung
project_kinds.description: Shared supply within a building: final consumers of one building use, under a building electricity use contract, the electricity of an installation on, at or in that building, without passing through a grid, each receiving the share of an allocation key per 15-minute interval; the operator does not owe them their full supply.

project_kinds.name: Gemeinsame Nutzung (Energy Sharing)
project_kinds.description: Energy sharing through the distribution grid: the operator of a renewable installation, or of a storage fed from renewables only — a natural person, or a company whose members are all final consumers or public bodies — supplies other final consumers (households, small and medium enterprises, public bodies) through the public distribution grid under a supply contract and a sharing contract that sets an allocation key; every consumption point and the installation are metered quarter-hourly.

project_kinds.name: Bürgerenergiegesellschaft
project_kinds.description: A citizens' energy company: a cooperative or other company of at least 50 natural persons with voting rights, at least 75 % of the votes held by natural persons registered in a postal code area wholly or partly within 50 km of the planned installation, the other votes held only by small and medium enterprises or municipalities, and no member above 10 % of the votes; it may be exempted from tenders.
project_kinds.reference: EEG 2023, § 3 number 15 (definition) and § 22 (2) and (3) (exemption from tenders)
